name: 林榮禾
objective:
本課程教導學生對製造業與服務業進行精實化管理的策略與技巧。課程內容包含：造成大型企業倒閉的商務環境改變與組織內的問題；科技提昇與電子化管理對企業的衝擊；精實化企業中有效及具競爭力營運管理的要素；精實化管理的發展策略與技巧。探討競爭優勢與生產服務系統模式、經營模式之關連，包括大量客製化、競爭優勢階段性、 發展競爭優勢作為、 豐富顧客價值。本課程將使學員熟習各項品質管理的理論基礎與發展趨勢，強化理論研究與實務應用能力。首先，課程涵蓋基礎統計使學員具備研究方法與分析技術能力，了解收集、統整和分析資料。其次，討論量化的六標準差管理相關工具及專案推行流程，以系統化思維探討問題並提出有效可行的解決對策，持續提升品質及客戶滿意。最後，介紹制度面及組織管理面的全球品管概念，闡述創造魅力品質之重要理論模型及影響服務品質關鍵因素。
This course covers the strategies and techniques of managing a lean business in manufacturing and in service. The linkages between competitive advantages and production systems, competitive advantages and business models will be discussed first. Then, topics include mass customization, competitive advantage stages, developing competitive capability and maximize customer value. This class will help students familiarize themselves with the trend of theoretical basis of the quality management and strengthen their ability in both theoretical research and practical application. First, the course covers basic statistics so that students will be acquainted with research methods and analysis techniques. Second, the six sigma management tools will be reviewed and the process for its implementation will also be addressed. Finally, the system- and the organization-level quality as well as the Kano Model for attractive quality will be discussed.
schedule:
第 1 週：精實戰略與商業變革 (Lean Strategy)
第 2 週：價值流治理與數位轉型 (Value Stream & Digital)
第 3 週：供應鏈韌性與拉式經營 (Supply Chain & Pull)
第 4 週：精實醫療與服務業流程創新 (Service & Innovation)
第 5 週：建立精實企業文化與人才培育 (Lean Culture)
第 6 週：EMBA 精實專案發表與實務變革 (Project & Action)

name: 黃乾怡
objective:
本課程旨在教導學生理解製造業與服務業精實化管理之策略與技巧。在品質管理與持續改善方面，本課程將介紹 Sigma 的意涵、六標準差管理工具與專案推行流程，使學生能以系統化思維進行問題定義、資料分析、改善對策擬定與品質績效提升。課程亦涵蓋基礎統計、量測系統分析、管制圖、製程能力分析、田口品質工程等方法，使學生具備資料蒐集、統整、分析與製程改善之能力，進一步強化品質穩定性與顧客滿意度。此外，課程將結合現代品質管理與產品開發工具，包括二維品質模型、品質機能展開、失效模式及效應分析、產品可靠度設計與分析等，使學生了解如何從顧客需求、產品設計、潛在失效風險與可靠度角度進行品質規劃與改善。同時，課程亦導入層級分析法、資料探勘、機器學習與大數據分析等方法，探討其在智慧製造、決策支援與品質管理中的應用。透過理論學習與案例分析，學生將能熟悉品質管理之理論基礎、發展趨勢與應用工具，進而提升其在製造與服務系統中進行精實化管理、品質改善與智慧決策之能力。 

This course helps students understand lean management strategies and techniques in manufacturing and service industries. It introduces Sigma, Six Sigma tools, and project processes to help students define problems, analyze data, propose improvements, and improve quality performance. The course also covers basic statistics, measurement system analysis, control charts, process capability analysis, and Taguchi quality engineering. These methods help students collect and analyze data, improve processes, and enhance quality stability and customer satisfaction. In addition, the course includes modern quality and product development tools, such as the Kano Model, QFD, FMEA, and product reliability analysis. Students will learn how to improve quality from the perspectives of customer needs, product design, failure risks, and reliability. The course also introduces AHP, data mining, machine learning, and big data analytics, and discusses their applications in smart manufacturing, decision support, and quality management. Through theories and case studies, students will develop the ability to apply lean management, quality improvement, and intelligent decision-making in manufacturing and service systems.
schedule:
Week 7~8: 6 Sigma 意涵、大數據分析與智慧製造
Week 9~10: 二維品質模型（Kano Model）、品質機能展開（ QFD ）
Week 11: 失效模式及效應分析 (FMEA)、量測系統分析 (MSA)
Week 12: 管制圖 (Control chart)、製程能力分析 (Cp & Cpk)
Week 13: 田口品質工程 (Taguchi quality engineering)
Week 14: 層級分析法 (AHP)
Week 15~16: 資料探勘與機器學習
Week 17~18: 產品可考靠度設計與分析
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG12：負責任的消費與生產（Responsible Consumption and Production）
